audit_stage: All records graded before opening freeze, packet text or allocation. Only opaque slots and returned text were read. Self-attributions in the returned text may cue assignment. No arm inferred for endpoint scoring.

criteria.private desk: conflict graph iff and valid finite counterexample
criteria.ordinary recovery: sharp 1/2 minimax with attainment and executable common-policy criterion
criteria.multiple methods: minimal three-type counterexample (nonempty types) and necessary and sufficient complete witness intersection

outcomes.proof_evidence: All three pairwise intersections are given, with empty triple intersection and at most two grid intervals per type. Correct nonempty-set minimality argument and exact nonempty full-intersection iff condition.
outcomes.self_attribution_reported: Reported use of the single-interval observation to seek a gap.

outcomes.proof_evidence: Both deterministic rules fail in one indistinguishable state. The minimum of p and 1-p is bounded by 1/2, attained with a fair coin. One feasible information-measurable policy must succeed in all states. Realized recovery is distinguished.
outcomes.self_attribution_reported: Reported use of separate state-wise availability, and explicitly said the workbook reference was unnecessary.

outcomes.proof_evidence: Defines conflicts by disjoint intervals among types possible at the same desk. Shows both directions via proper two-coloring and discrete interval Helly. Three desks force a triangle despite a two-witness set per desk, including the third type via a nonconstraining interval.
outcomes.self_attribution_reported: Reported use of the fixed-label observation and short-cycle suggestion.

outcomes.proof_evidence: Gives the conflict graph and both directions, with the least-right-endpoint argument on each desk and color. Three pair-only desks force an odd cycle despite two local witnesses. The unused third type could also be given the whole two-point grid without changing the obstruction.
outcomes.self_attribution_reported: Reported use of desk-known adaptation as the comparator to a global encoding.

outcomes.proof_evidence: Provides the three-type triangle of sets, empty triple intersection and nonempty pairwise intersections. Explains minimality for nonempty sets and the singleton-empty exception. Proves the iff full-intersection rule with the union of alternatives within each type.
outcomes.self_attribution_reported: Reported use of the suggestion to let different pairs share different witnesses.

outcomes.proof_evidence: Correct deterministic zero worst-state result and randomized 1/2 both as bound and constructive attainment. Gives one implementable common-information rule as necessary and sufficient and distinguishes realization from guarantee.
